Residents:
Ines (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: friends, music, houseplants.
Yuki (70s, retired): Weekdays home most of the day; morning walk, afternoon errands. Weekends home most of the day; late-morning walk. Hobbies: meditation, movies, houseplants. Cares for the dog.
Hana (40s, WFH): Weekdays at desk 9:00–17:30, sometimes out for lunch. Weekends sleeps in, midday errands, home otherwise. Hobbies: movies, snacking.

Object Locations & Routines:
All residents were home for all Sunday patrols (00:00–20:00).

Kitchen (Active Zone):
- cutting_board_shared: Usually counter_k1. Moves to sink_k1/dish_rack_k1 during meal prep/cleanup (20:00).
- glass_hana, glass_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Moved to kitchen_table_k1 at 16:00 (evening use).
- glass_ines: Usually cupboard_k1. Moved to sink_k1 at 00:00, pantry_shelf_k1 at 16:00, kitchen_table_k1 at 20:00.
- kitchen_knife_shared, spatula_shared: Usually drawer_k_k1. Moved to counter_k1/sink_k1 at 20:00 (cooking/cleaning).
- pan_shared, pot_shared, serving_dish_shared: Usually cupboard_k1. Moved to dish_rack_k1/counter_k1 at 20:00 (cooking/cleaning).
- plate_hana, plate_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Moved to sink_k1/dish_rack_k1 at 16:00-20:00 (dinner).
- plate_ines: Usually cupboard_k1. Moved to dish_rack_k1 at 16:00, kitchen_table_k1 at 20:00.
- water_bottle_yuki: Usually desk_b1. Moved to kitchen_table_k1 at 20:00.
- water_bottle_hana: Usually desk_o1. Moved to sink_k1/counter_k1 at 16:00-20:00.
- water_bottle_ines: Usually kitchen_table_k1. Moved to dish_rack_k1 at 00:00, kitchen_table_k1 at 20:00.
- bowl_hana, bowl_ines, bowl_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Moved to sink_k1/kitchen_table_k1 at 08:00-12:00 (breakfast/lunch).
- mug_hana: Usually desk_o1. Moves to kitchen_table_k1/sink_k1 during work breaks.
- mug_ines: Usually coffee_table_l1. Moves to sink_k1 at 12:00.
- mug_yuki: Usually cupboard_k1. Moves to sink_k1 at 12:00.
- dog_food_bag_shared: Usually pantry_shelf_k1. Moved to floor_k_k1 at 00:00, back to pantry_shelf_k1 at 12:00.

Entry & Personal Items:
- jacket_yuki: Usually entry_hook_e1. Moved to wardrobe_b1 at 12:00, dresser_b1 at 08:00.
- jacket_ines: Usually entry_hook_e1. Moved to shoe_rack_e1 at 00:00.
- keys_hana: Usually entry_table_e1. Moved to entry_floor_e1 at 20:00.
- keys_yuki: Usually entry_table_e1.
- shoes_yuki, shoes_ines: Usually shoe_rack_e1. Moved to entry_floor_e1 at 12:00/20:00.
- phone_ines: Usually coffee_table_l1. Not in any room
